verses.en: Finally, brethren, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may have free course, and be glorified, even as it is with you:
verses.pt: Nas demais coisas, irmãos, rogai por nós, para que a palavra do Senhor continue seu percurso, e seja glorificada, assim como também entre vós;
verses.en_web: Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may spread rapidly and be glorified, even as also with you;
verses.en_bbe: For the rest, my brothers, let there be prayer for us that the word of the Lord may go forward with increasing glory, even as it does with you;

verses.en: And that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men: for all men have not faith.
verses.pt: E para que sejamos livres de homens corruptos e maus, porque a fé não é de todos.
verses.en_web: and that we may be delivered from unreasonable and evil men; for not all have faith.
verses.en_bbe: And that we may be made free from foolish and evil men; for not all have faith.

verses.en: But the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.
verses.pt: Mas fiel é o Senhor, que vos fortalecerá e vos guardará do maligno.
verses.en_web: But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you, and guard you from the evil one.
verses.en_bbe: But the Lord is true, who will give you strength and keep you safe from evil.

verses.en: And we have confidence in the Lord touching you, that ye both do and will do the things which we command you.
verses.pt: E confiamos no Senhor quanto a vós, de que vós estais fazendo e continuareis a fazer o que vos mandamos.
verses.en_web: We have confidence in the Lord concerning you, that you both do and will do the things we command.
verses.en_bbe: And we have faith in the Lord about you, that you are doing and will do the things about which we give you orders.

verses.en: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patient waiting for Christ.
verses.pt: E o Senhor guie vossos corações para o amor de Deus e a paciência de Cristo.
verses.en_web: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love, and into the perseverance of Christ.
verses.en_bbe: And may your hearts be guided by the Lord into the love of God and quiet waiting for Christ.

verses.en: Now we command you, brethren, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly, and not after the tradition which he received of us.
verses.pt: Mas nós vos mandamos, irmãos, no nome de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, que mantenhais distância de todo irmão que anda desordenadamente, e não segundo a tradição que recebeu de nós.
verses.en_web: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you withdraw yourselves from every brother who walks in rebellion, and not after the tradition which they received from us.
verses.en_bbe: Now we give you orders, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to keep away from all those whose behaviour is not well ordered and in harmony with the teaching which they had from us.

verses.en: For yourselves know how ye ought to follow us: for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you;
verses.pt: Porque vós mesmos sabeis como deveis nos imitar; porque nós não fomos desordenados entre vós;
verses.en_web: For you know how you ought to imitate us. For we didn’t behave ourselves rebelliously among you,
verses.en_bbe: For you yourselves are used to taking us as your example, because our life among you was ruled by order,

verses.en: Neither did we eat any man’s bread for nought; but wrought with labour and travail night and day, that we might not be chargeable to any of you:
verses.pt: Nem comemos de graça o pão de qualquer um, mas sim com trabalho e cansaço trabalhamos de noite e de dia, para não sermos incômodos a nenhum de vós.
verses.en_web: neither did we eat bread from anyone’s hand without paying for it, but in labor and travail worked night and day, that we might not burden any of you;
verses.en_bbe: And we did not take food from any man for nothing, but were working hard night and day not to be a trouble to any of you:

verses.en: Not because we have not power, but to make ourselves an ensample unto you to follow us.
verses.pt: Não porque não tivéssemos autoridade para fazer isso, mas porque nós mesmos dávamos exemplo a vós, para assim nos imitardes.
verses.en_web: not because we don’t have the right, but to make ourselves an example to you, that you should imitate us.
verses.en_bbe: Not because we have not the right, but to make ourselves an example to you, so that you might do the same.

verses.en: For even when we were with you, this we commanded you, that if any would not work, neither should he eat.
verses.pt: Porque, quando ainda estávamos convosco, isto vos mandamos: que se alguém não quiser trabalhar, também não coma.
verses.en_web: For even when we were with you, we commanded you this: “If anyone will not work, don’t let him eat.”
verses.en_bbe: For even when we were with you we gave you orders, saying, If any man does no work, let him not have food.

verses.en: For we hear that there are some which walk among you disorderly, working not at all, but are busybodies.
verses.pt: Porque ouvimos que alguns entre vós andam desordenadamente, não trabalhando, mas se intrometendo no que os outros fazem.
verses.en_web: For we hear of some who walk among you in rebellion, who don’t work at all, but are busybodies.
verses.en_bbe: For it has come to our ears that there are some among you whose behaviour is uncontrolled, who do no work at all, but are over-interested in the business of others.

verses.en: Now them that are such we command and exhort by our Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.
verses.pt: Mas aos tais mandamos e exortamos, por nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, que trabalhem sem causar incômodo, e comam seu próprio pão.
verses.en_web: Now those who are that way, we command and exhort in the Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.
verses.en_bbe: Now to such we give orders and make request in the Lord Jesus, that, working quietly, they get their living.

verses.en: But ye, brethren, be not weary in well doing.
verses.pt: E vós, irmãos, não vos canseis de fazer o bem.
verses.en_web: But you, brothers, don’t be weary in doing what is right.
verses.en_bbe: And you, my brothers, do not get tired of well-doing.

verses.en: And if any man obey not our word by this epistle, note that man, and have no company with him, that he may be ashamed.
verses.pt: Mas se alguém não obedecer à nossa palavra contida nesta carta, adverti-o, e não vos mistureis com ele, para que ele se envergonhe;
verses.en_web: If any man doesn’t obey our word in this letter, note that man, that you have no company with him, to the end that he may be ashamed.
verses.en_bbe: And if any man does not give attention to what we have said in this letter, take note of that man, and keep away from him, so that he may be shamed.

verses.en: Yet count him not as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.
verses.pt: E não o considereis como inimigo, mas alertai -o como um irmão.
verses.en_web: Don’t count him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.
verses.en_bbe: Have no feeling of hate for him, but take him in hand seriously as a brother.

verses.en: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord be with you all.
verses.pt: E o mesmo Senhor da paz vos dê sempre paz em toda maneira. O Senhor seja com todos vós.
verses.en_web: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.
verses.en_bbe: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times and in every way. May the Lord be with you all.

verses.en: The salutation of Paul with mine own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so I write.
verses.pt: A saudação de minha própria mão, Paulo, que é minha assinatura em toda carta; assim escrevo.
verses.en_web: The greeting of me, Paul, with my own hand, which is the sign in every letter: this is how I write.
verses.en_bbe: These words of love to you at the end are in my writing, Paul's writing, and this is the mark of every letter from me.

verses.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
verses.pt: A graça de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo seja com todos vós. Amém. A segunda carta aos tessalonicenses foi escrita de Atenas
verses.en_web: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
verses.en_bbe: May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.
